items.title: User Embeddings are Superpositions of Interpretable Behavioral Modes
items.summary: User embeddings are central components of modern recommendation, personalization, and behavioral modeling systems. Though these embeddings can compactly encode rich behavioral information, they are inherently dense and opaque, limiting interpretability. To address this gap, we argue that user embeddings can be understood as sparse superpositions of interpretable behavioral modes. This structure is directly predicted by generative models of user behavior for linear embeddings and extends approximately to deep-learning representations by the superposition hypothesis. news.title_zh: 用户嵌入是可解释行为模式的叠加
news.lede: 该论文提出，推荐系统中的用户嵌入向量可以被理解为多个可解释行为模式的稀疏叠加。
news.why: 它提供了一种理解AI推荐系统如何解读用户行为的新视角，让黑箱模型更易理解。

items.title: Do You Miss the Nights We Spent Crafting Figures? Rethinking Teaser and Framework Figures in the Age of Generative AI
items.summary: Scientific figures give research ideas a visual form through choices of abstraction, composition, and emphasis. Generative AI offers new ways to realize these choices, raising questions about explanatory clarity and purposeful visual expression. We examine these questions through a visual retrospective of 371 motivation and framework figures from 200 papers. news.title_zh: AI时代下，科研图示的变与思
news.lede: 这篇论文通过回顾371张科研论文中的动机与框架图示，探讨了生成式AI对科学图示表达清晰度与设计意图的影响。
news.why: 它帮助我们思考，当AI能轻易生成精美图片时，科研图示的核心价值与沟通目的何在。

items.title: Where and Why is Grounded Reasoning Useful?
items.summary: Grounded reasoning, where a model outputs text coordinates of relevant locations in chain-of-thought reasoning, is a common strategy for solving complex visual reasoning problems. However, the benefits and limitations of grounded reasoning are understudied. We study where and why grounded reasoning is most useful. To do so, we introduce a chain-of-thought analysis method to measure how much a model uses its outputted grounding in its thinking trace and perform a detailed ablation study of a grounded reasoning training recipe. news.title_zh: 视觉推理中，何时何地需要“定位”思考？
news.lede: 这篇论文研究了在视觉推理任务中，让模型在思考链中输出具体坐标位置（即“定位推理”）的实际作用与局限性。
news.why: 它揭示了这种看似直观的AI思考方式，其真正有效的场景可能比想象中更具体。

items.title: SwarmEvolve: Latent Agent Swarms for Evolutionary Discovery and Optimization
items.summary: LLM-guided evolutionary search uses AI agents to improve programs for mathematical and computational problems by iteratively refining solutions and combining high-scoring methods. However, the process is often slow because the LLM generates a long textual chain of thought for each round and must repeat this generation many times to maintain population diversity. news.lede: 该研究提出了一种让数百个低成本AI智能体在潜在空间协同进化、无需生成文本即可优化程序的新框架。
news.why: 它展示了如何让AI更高效地协作解决问题，为理解群体智能提供了新视角。

items.title: Scientist World: Grow a Research World for AI-Scientists
items.summary: AI-Scientists arrived, but a world for them to grow in did not. Human scientists take theirs for granted $-$ centuries of open problems and shared ideas, waiting in the scientific literature. To AI-Scientists, that world is readable but not runnable, so we build Scientist World for them: every research paper becomes an executable environment. Our autonomous pipeline extracts each paper's open-ended research question and reproduces its proposed method as the baseline; an AI-Scientist entering the environment is evaluated against what the human authors achieved. items.note: 语言模型、翻译、对话与评测

news.title_zh: 科学家世界：为AI科学家构建可执行的研究环境

news.why: 它展示了如何让AI更直接地参与和评估真实的科研过程，是AI与科学交叉领域的一次具体尝试。

items.title: EgoGeneralist: Unifying Egocentric Action-Video Tasks through Video-Native Modeling
items.summary: Modern video models possess strong visual priors, yet do not natively represent human action in metric 3D space. news.why: 它展示了如何让AI更自然地理解和生成与人类动作紧密相关的视频内容。

items.title: XStack: A Benchmark for ML Repo Migration
items.summary: ML code should run where researchers choose, not where it was first written. Today, machine learning code mainly lives in two ecosystems, PyTorch on NVIDIA GPUs and JAX on Google TPUs. Migrating repositories between them means building and testing across frameworks and hardware. This migration is (1) a practical need, since it unlocks different hardware for researchers, and (2) a natural benchmark: it involves different frameworks and hardware, covers whole repositories, and is long-horizon and challenging. news.why: 它揭示了让AI代码跨平台运行的实际挑战，这关系到未来AI开发的灵活性与效率。

news.title_zh: 相同行为，不同机制：有限实验能揭示什么
news.lede: 这篇论文探讨了如何通过有限的、有噪声的实验干预，来推断一个系统内部的计算机制，而非仅仅观察其输出行为。
news.why: 它揭示了AI系统内部运作的复杂性，提醒我们仅凭外部表现来评估其“意识”或理解其机制是困难的。

items.title: Towards interpreting any residual stream direction by scaling activation inversion
items.summary: To interpret a direction in a language model's residual stream, we can look for text that strongly activates it. But when such text is found by scanning a corpus, it is limited to what that corpus contains. We develop Maximally-Activating Example Metamodels (MAEMs), language models which map residual stream directions from a subject model to text exemplars that strongly activate those directions. news.why: 它提供了一种更灵活的方法来理解AI模型内部的运作，而不必依赖固定的文本库。

items.title: Adversarial Training with Large Step Sizes: Implicit Bias, Optimization, and Sharpness
items.summary: Adversarial Training (AT) is an important method for improving model robustness. We study the dynamics of deterministic Gradient Descent (GD) in AT. Most existing works in this direction focus on the small or vanishing step sizes regime, where GD resembles a continuous-time flow. However, such step sizes can make training inefficient and are rarely used in practice. In this paper, we study the AT dynamics of GD with large constant step sizes. news.why: 它揭示了实际训练中常用的大学习率设置如何影响模型鲁棒性的形成过程。

items.title: ReproBridge: Building Reproducibility into ML Research Artifacts
items.summary: Reproducing machine learning experiments requires reconstructing procedures from information scattered across papers, released code, and supporting artifacts. For coding agents, reproduction success can therefore depend on their ability to fill in missing details, rather than on the released artifacts alone. news.why: 它为解决AI研究中普遍存在的实验难以复现的问题，提供了一个具体、可操作的框架。

news.why: 它让AI在理解物理世界时，能更快、更省资源地预测物体的位置和运动轨迹。

news.why: 它展示了如何更精细地建模动态对抗环境中的不确定性，对理解智能系统的决策预测有启发。

news.why: 它提供了一种理解复杂交通环境中骑行安全的新方法，而不仅仅是依赖事故统计。

items.title: Understanding AI from the Inside: The State of Mechanistic Interpretability for AI Safety
items.summary: Neural networks are likely to be among the most consequential artefacts in human history. As these systems become more capable and autonomous, their potential to cause societal harm also grows, making AI safety one of the defining challenges of our time. Yet we continue to build increasingly powerful systems without fully understanding how they work, how they will behave in unfamiliar situations, or how to reliably control them. news.why: 它解释了为何理解AI内部运作对确保其安全可控至关重要。

news.why: 它展示了AI如何从日常视频中提取出更精确的三维动态场景，是迈向理解动态世界的一步。

news.why: 它解决了AI医疗助手在多次问诊中可能出现的记忆错误，让对话更可靠。

news.why: 它展示了如何让AI更深入地理解和使用我们日常的软件工具，而不仅仅是聊天。
